narrative:
## Handover Summary — COGS Planning

Cost driver models validated across all COGS categories. Gross margin forecast confirmed at 50.6% budget.

## Recommendation for Headcount Phase
Model direct headcount against the 1+11 Forecast volume trajectory, starting with Merchandise.

signals.title: Resort Hotels RevPAR EUR 3.3 below forecast — occupancy, not ADR
signals.source: SDP Hotel Revenue — 7 hotels, occupancy × ADR, booking-curve pace
signals.excerpt: October 2026 RevPAR was EUR 325.6 against EUR 328.9 forecast. ADR held at EUR 369 (+EUR 6 vs forecast), but occupancy was 88.2% against 90.5%: Davy Crockett Ranch (−EUR 16.6 RevPAR) and Hotel Santa Fe (−EUR 15.0) ran 6–7 points behind on weaker UK package pickup.

signals.title: UK visits −8% and energy +30% would take EUR 43.6M off FY2027 EBITDA
signals.source: SDP Scenario Analysis — energy kWh × price, cast hours × pay rate
signals.excerpt: UK & Ireland visits −8% (−EUR 19.4M with 60% flow-through) and electricity repriced 30% higher from January (−EUR 24.2M) take FY2027 EBITDA from EUR 558.9M to EUR 515.3M (16.9%) before mitigation. A 3.8% NAO pay round would cost a further EUR 15.0M vs the 2.5% budget assumption.
